name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding Manager | Onboarding Plans, Risk & Dependency Management, Handoff to CS
summary: Onboarding manager who runs the journey from contract handoff to launch and a clean transition to Customer Success. At Wix I ran up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets, while leading onboarding teams of up to 30. At Accelo I built sequenced implementation plans from sales handoff, deciding which systems to change and in what order. I track milestones and risks, escalate early, and hold internal teams and customers to their commitments.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for service businesses, including electrical, plumbing, and HVAC trades: kickoff, requirements, configuration, data setup, and training.
Built automated appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, reactivation of lapsed customers, and review requests across a 20+ workflow system.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent across implementations to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded 15-20 reseller partners and ensured every partner's end customers were set up on Birdeye's listings solution, the backbone of the offer, retaining all but one partner (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists over 2 years, piloting different team structures as a new vertical scaled from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Ran weekly team training, workshops for new initiatives, and 1:1 coaching, and contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new hires and to sales training for tenured account executives.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent, holding 110% of implementation targets, while overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients from sales handoff, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and escalated risks to leadership early.
